relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: Substance P and CGRPα are therefore not essential for mechanical or cold allodynia.

relationships.subject: CGRPα
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, Substance P and CGRPα are dispensable for some forms of neurogenic inflammation.

key_findings: Tac1/Calca double knockout mice lacking Substance P and CGRPα show largely intact acute, inflammatory and neuropathic pain behaviors.
CFA, PGE2 hypersensitivity and capsaicin-evoked neurogenic inflammation were unaffected by loss of both peptides.
